name: coordinator-single-writer
body: The session coordinator is the single writer of the worktree DB: while a session is live, it owns `apg/.trans/db.lbug` exclusively (one writer → no concurrent lbug open), and it applies routed mutations in the order it receives them. Any other would-be DB opener either routes through the session or waits. Acceptance: with a live session, no competing process opens the DB read-write; the resulting store equals the serial application of the same mutations.
